mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_msg_read_bitmap (msg_id, group_id, delivered_bitmap, delivered_count, read_bitmap, read_count, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{msgId}, #{groupId}, #{deliveredBitmap}, #{deliveredCount}, #{readBitmap}, #{readCount}, NOW(), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE delivered_bitmap = VALUES(delivered_bitmap), delivered_count = VALUES(delivered_count), read_bitmap = VALUES(read_bitmap), read_count = VALUES(read_count), updated_at = NOW()
